scope: NATIVE_LIVE_MOTION_QUERY only; offline static contract audit

identity.native_gate: exact known EnemyActor script identity/inheritance; GDScript `is EnemyActor` semantics. Ordinary members may be read through Godot Object.get; no private-memory offset or extra bridge is implied.
identity.prohibited: Object.is_class("EnemyActor") is insufficient because it does not test script class_name identity

fields.name: self.a/self.b
fields.read: by value; finite status is owned by caller _hc_motion_clear_internal at 8847-8848

fields.name: candidates
fields.read: raw identity/order; no copy or reorder

fields.name: self._hc_surround_goal
fields.read: finite branch only; target special gate

fields.name: self.target
fields.read: is_instance_valid then global_position; target radius via _target_combat_radius_gu

fields.name: self.spatial_actor_runtime_id
fields.read: not consumed by motion body loop; only HCPolicy core may receive it indirectly only in frontline, so do not add

fields.name: other.global_position
fields.read: formal ground position; current live read

algorithm_order: if surround goal finite and target valid: project target.global_position and core_crossed target; return false on crossing

for raw in original candidate Array order: validity and EnemyActor identity; skip self/target; same runtime_map_id; increment enemy_motion_body_checks; read current formal ground position; conservative envelope reject; can_receive_damage; behavior_profile.worldCollision; exact HCPolicy.core_crossed; return false at first crossing

projection_cache.known_safe_hit: Object.get may read ordinary underscore members. The cache fields are the declared typed fields `_last_spatial_index_screen_position_px: Vector2`, `_last_spatial_index_ground_position_gu: Vector2`, `_last_spatial_index_runtime_map_id: int`, `_last_spatial_index_zone_generation: int`, `_last_spatial_index_environment_revision: int`, `_last_spatial_index_projection: Callable` (scripts/enemy.gd:567-572). Predicate at 3285-3296 requires valid runtime_screen_to_ground_position_px, exact current screen, map, zone generation, environment revision, and exact projection Callable; hit returns the current stored ground value at 3299-3306.
projection_cache.miss: must stay legacy _screen_position_px_to_ground_position_gu path at 3377-3404; typed callback at 3413-3418; mapped invalid/missing returns Vector2.INF and increments rejection state 3419-3427
projection_cache.environment_revision: Known exact `WorldBackground` provider is `class_name WorldBackground` and `environment_collision_revision() -> int` returns plain `_environment_collision_revision` (scripts/world_background.gd:1,112,337-338), so native may directly read that field only after exact script identity. Unknown provider keeps the original `_hc_environment_revision` call at its original helper point; do not pre-call it and then invoke the helper again.
projection_cache.target_special: target ground projection at 10307-10310 is only on finite surround_goal + valid target branch; do not eagerly project distant candidates
projection_cache.target_cache_fields: Target-only cache is separate: `_target_ground_cache_physics_frame: int`, target instance id: int, target screen/ground Vector2, runtime map int, zone generation int, projection Callable (scripts/enemy.gd:577-583); predicate 3430-3444. Motion target special uses the normal helper and only reaches this cache when target identity/position matches.

can_receive_damage.native_condition: only for exact EnemyActor implementation with fields read live; no cached HP/life shadow

provider_contract.supported: Exact EnemyActor implementation plus exact known WorldBackground provider for the revision read. Ordinary Dictionary/Object.get reads are callback-free; preserve Variant-to-bool conversion for behavior_profile["worldCollision"].
provider_contract.unknown: Unknown Enemy subclass: native may still enter the scan if the scan implementation itself is inherited unchanged, but any unknown overridden callee is invoked at the original loop point only. Unknown projection/environment provider calls the original legacy helper at the original point; no whole-query restart after partial counters/effects.
provider_contract.reentry: A legacy projection/provider callback can mutate owner, target, candidate, index, or destroy an object. After that call, continue only with the exact fields the original code reads next (validity/type, map, position, eligibility, behavior profile, radii); reread them live. If the callback destroys the object, preserve the original invalid-instance/legacy error behavior; do not add a conservative native rejection or silently continue.

index_boundary.candidate_pool: RuntimeCombatSpatialIndex query supplies live EnemyActor nodes; index does stale deletion, map/bucket filtering and appends at 390-440
index_boundary.writer_visibility: Object.get is permitted for ordinary GDScript members, including underscore cache fields; it is not a private-memory bridge. Position/index update remains synchronous and stale indexed Dictionary position is never authoritative when the formal read misses.
index_boundary.native_scope: does not move actors, update index, write position, call signals, or alter candidate pool

diagnostics.semantics: preserve counter names, order, and amount; no batched flush or observer-only replacement

gaps: A cache miss can call GDScript projection and environment revision; unknown/overridden callback reentry prevents continuing with pre-call locals.
behavior_profile is a mutable Dictionary; known EnemyActor route must read it at the original post-envelope point, and any callback/reentry invalidates prior facts.
target special projection may be a callback and can mutate state; if provider is unknown, fallback before counter/target branch or re-read exactly.
No proof of net performance or >=50% coverage; this contract is one bounded execution replacement only.
Object.get ordinary GDScript members is available, but dynamic lookup/type conversion cost must be included in the experiment; no private memory offset is allowed.
Unknown callbacks may destroy owner/target/candidate; preserve legacy invalid-instance/error behavior and do not add a new conservative rejection.
decision: feasible as a single bounded execution replacement: inherited EnemyActor scans may route known pure reads, unknown overridden callees/providers stay at their original loop/helper point, and whole-entry fallback is reserved only for an uncloseable callback/reentry boundary; no source mutation/tests performed.
